comparison.objective: Hold an LED flush while applying a soldering-iron tip to one pad, then return the iron.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained bimanual micro-alignment of a component and pointed tool.
comparison.success_condition: Two seconds of uninterrupted pad contact while LED remains flush, with no forbidden contact; iron returned safely.
comparison.reason: This tests precision holding and timed contact, not hex-key torque, adjustable damping, relocking, or response-based iteration.
